head_commit.message:
Add abrupt-stop interruptions and parenthesized boolean guards

The interruption harness now also ends each interrupted run abruptly: it restores the local state captured at the injection boundary, so progress saved only in catch or finally blocks cannot hide a recovery bug. The mutation generator recognizes 'return ($true)' and 'return ($false)' as guard results.
